The module and the reference page state (a) the conversion of the Alfven speed between a thin-disc and a whole-halo reacceleration zone and (b) the momentum-diffusion coefficient normalisations used by DRAGON2 cd588707 and USINE V3.5, each from the code (file:line) or from a paper equation read in full text; each conversion is marked exact or approximate with a stated bound; nothing is taken from memory.

entries.criterion: Round trips of the reacceleration parameters between the dragon2 and usine conventions reproduce the input within 1e-12 relative where the conversion is exact, and an approximate conversion returns its bound.
